scope: Reconcile existing paired VisualStyle writer evidence with the evidence-grade sidecar and deepen the strict-versus-recovery DXF peer validation boundary using current primary project documentation.

method.kind: Existing receipt audit plus primary documentation review and local plan/validator consistency update
method.evidenceBoundary: Documentation and prior paired writer output establish route-specific observations only. Recovery, TagStorage, and partial ACIS decoding do not establish clean readback, semantics, or support. No peer rerun or support promotion occurred.

pairedVisualStyleEvidence.interpretation: Empirically observed writer output only. Primary tag-sequence concordance does not establish semantic slot mapping. Group-176 behavior, value disagreements, CMC method/value policy, group-177 policy, producer truth, and serializer admission remain unresolved. Neither output was an independent readback of the other.

observed: Ordinary readfile and recovery are distinct routes; recover may report decoding faults as unrecoverable AuditError.DECODE_ERRORS without raising DXFStructureError.
Documentation warns that writing a recovered file with such decoding errors may produce invalid DXF or lose information and provides errors='strict' to reject these decode errors.
Unsupported DXF entity types may be held as TagStorage and re-exported, which is raw retention rather than semantic understanding or graph closure.

Unsupported ACIS entities may load as NONE_ENTITY with data loss; exporting NONE_ENTITY raises ExportError. The documented geometry target focuses on flat polyhedral faces, not arbitrary B-rep coverage.
primaryDocumentation.planUse: Keep strict parse, recover/audit diagnostics, raw tag retention, and ACIS semantic outcomes as separate receipts and gates.

observed: RawCodeValues is option-gated; block references can remain separate with INLINE_BLOCKS=NO.
Binary DXF reading is documented from GDAL 3.12; AC1027+ raw ASM extensibility is separately documented, so combined support must be demonstrated by the exact pinned runtime.
primaryDocumentation.planUse: Bind options and ASCII/binary profile per run; do not infer feature combinations from separate documentation entries.
